judgeRationales.scenarioName: Scaffold Blazor CRUD components
judgeRationales.rationale: Both provide a credible, tested Employee CRUD implementation, but B satisfies the important explicit requirement to use EF Core migrations whereas A uses EnsureCreated. B also more comprehensively supports the Department relationship.

judgeRationales.scenarioName: Scaffold MVC CRUD with an existing DbContext
judgeRationales.rationale: Both appear to fulfill the requested implementation. A has stronger end-to-end evidence for the required Book/Author relationship and every CRUD endpoint, and explicitly addresses the required-navigation validation issue; B has a marginally nicer no-author navigation affordance.

judgeRationales.scenarioName: Scaffold Minimal API child and required parent CRUD
judgeRationales.rationale: Both solutions appear complete, verified, and satisfy the core data, CRUD, migration, and HTTP-workflow requirements. B is stronger chiefly because it clearly supplies comprehensive endpoint-level OpenAPI response and descriptive metadata, plus DTOs to prevent entity-navigation JSON cycles.

judgeRationales.scenarioName: Scaffold Minimal API endpoints with OpenAPI
judgeRationales.rationale: Both satisfy the core CRUD context/endpoints requirement, but B also fulfills the migration and HTTP-sample deliverables and provides substantially richer OpenAPI metadata, with end-to-end CRUD verification. A lacks evidence of all of those requested quality elements.

judgeRationales.scenarioName: Scaffold Razor Pages CRUD with EF Core and SQLite
judgeRationales.rationale: Both substantially satisfy the EF Core/SQLite/AppDbContext/Product CRUD requirements and provide build/runtime verification. B is more complete for the required foreign-key workflow by adding Category CRUD and navigation, while A omits that essential supporting UI.
